description: Consolidated the $O(N^2)$-overhead $get_muon_momentum$ and $get_weight_decay$ helper functions into direct inline parameter updates within `MuonAdamW.__init__`. This eliminated the parameter copying overhead associated with helper function calls during the optimizer initialization loop, drastically reducing initialization cost from $O(N^2)$ to $O(N)$ while preserving the training logic and memory footprint.
